objective: Expand the Git-backed candidate backlog across citation-led discovery, official GEE, Planetary Computer and Esri public datasets, prioritizing global coverage and existing native access.
prior_information: The prior 2026-10-29/30 citation rankings, GEE inventory and previous conversion decisions have already been reviewed. This is an expansion, not a blinded independent citation study.

scope.citation_lane: Review the first 50 global shared-paper groups in the frozen combined official/community ranking with deprecated official entries excluded; retain exact entry/version distinctions. Supplemental producer papers may be reviewed separately; do not call this all geospatial literature.
scope.gee_lane: Reuse the complete 2026-10-30 official metadata snapshot (1,165 entries) and reviewed paper identities; inspect primary catalog pages for shortlisted families as needed. No live GEE requests or exports.
scope.planetary_lane: Capture the current public STAC collections inventory, retain every collection in the discovery snapshot, and review documented global/near-global dataset families for canonical promotion.
scope.esri_lane: Search the public Living Atlas/ArcGIS catalog for worldwide feature services and relevant global raster products. Preserve exact queries, pages, counts and owner/authority checks. This bounded search is not an exhaustive census of ArcGIS Online.
scope.geography: Global, global land/ocean and near-global latitude-limited products are eligible with explicit coverage notes. Regional products stay in research inventory unless already canonical; no promotion based solely on a world-sized display extent.

selection_and_identity_rules: Use one canonical dataset.yaml per reviewed dataset family. Link provider editions/components explicitly; a shared title, paper DOI or bbox alone never proves equivalence.
Citation metric remains maximum associated-dataset-paper cited_by_count, not a sum. Data DOI counts remain separate, unknown is null, and each count retains provider and observation date.
Keep frozen 2026-10-29/30 citation values and evidence unchanged. Do not silently mix later observations into that ranking.
Existing COG, GeoParquet, Zarr or PMTiles access is a reuse signal; API/map/feature-service access is not proof of a downloadable cloud-native bulk release.
License and metadata declarations are evidence for review, not verified redistribution permission or byte-level data validation.
New candidates stay pending/candidate; existing triage and prepared/deferred statuses remain unchanged. Publication/hosting choices require subsequent dataset review.
acceptance_checks: Every promoted candidate has an authoritative source URL, explicit global/near-global coverage evidence, origin catalog IDs and a traceable research observation.
Store deterministic normalized provider snapshots and reproducible metadata capture commands; report failures, truncation and unreviewed coverage.
All 363 frozen community records remain and the three existing supplemental records retain identity, triage, source/build and immutable release evidence.
Generated index and readable candidate backlog reproduce offline from canonical records; the published STAC catalog remains at zero collections.
Reject invalid provider URLs, duplicate catalog references within a record, unsupported scope/status values and inconsistent cross-record exact matches.
Run focused schema/generator tests, existing record/provenance checks and a clean-checkout rehearsal for changed build inputs. Preserve material failed checks and corrected followups.
limitations: Selection is limited to the named catalogs and reviewed literature; citation prominence does not establish conversion value.
A metadata-only native-format observation is not a successful bulk download, COG/GeoParquet validation or hosting verification.
